evidence: Illustrative requirements inputs, not measurements, population predictions, design optima or upper bounds. The previous 1-10 g/m2 guard guess did not specify wet/dry mass; these NEW scenarios explicitly use live mass per footprint area.

parameter_sources.host_food_c_kg_per_footprint_m2_year: Reference allocation to ALL tenants in aerophytes/run.py Traits.consumer_food_c_kg_m2_year; not a new allocation per guard guild.
parameter_sources.animal_carbon_and_phosphorus: stoichiometry.py CONSUMER_C_PER_DRY; midpoint of TENANT_P_G_KG and CONSUMER_P_ASSIMILATION. P tissue range is the earlier study's insect analogue, not a measurement or appropriate default for every size or taxon.
parameter_sources.exterior_area: Sum raft_module zone areas in results/sky_ecology.json; curved envelope only, excluding added fringe.
parameter_sources.all_other_values: Illustrative design guesses chosen to expose scaling. No associated defensive efficacy, allometry, lunar behaviour or life-cycle validation. Speeds are independent illustrative inputs, not inferred from individual mass.

response.boundary: A local square grid on an idealised connected surface, nearest occupied nest, worst grid-cell point. Does not solve obstacle geometry, detection probability, guard availability, recruitment, occupancy, weather or fighting. A 2 m/s case is only a mobile comparison.

mixed_guild_boundary: All external supplies are stipulated exclusive allocations of food crossing the reef boundary, not demonstrated available food. No resident prey is counted as external food. External C and P are paired at 0.0159 kg P/kg C, the illustrative insect tissue midpoint divided by animal C content; supply is consumed first up to carbon demand and remaining demand draws on host allocation. P credit scales with consumed food C, before P assimilation. Eating additional food purely for P and disposing surplus C is not modelled. The same generic tissue and efficiency assumptions are used for illustration only; a large nester needs its own metabolism/diet model. Fixed production efficiency with varying turnover changes implied maintenance; near-zero turnover requires independent metabolic calibration and this screen cannot diagnose individual feeding requirements. Host food is screened as P-free sugar; no protein, nitrogen or essential-nutrient adequacy is implied. These guilds share 24% of the one host food budget; the rest remains unallocated.

nutrient_import_example.boundary: Separate illustrative whole-reef boundary account, not an additional supply silently credited to mixed guilds. Deposition share includes excretion, location and time spent on the reef. Exports are other outgoing reef P after deposition losses have already been counted; do not include those losses again. Internal recycling is excluded from new import.
